card.name: Words just before 'impact' or 'effect'
card.fires_on: Words right before a predicted 'impact', 'effect' or 'influence', such as 'and', 'no', 'potential', 'adverse', 'how' or 'effect' itself. It shows up where a sentence is about to say what one thing does to another.

modes.label: Linking or modifying word before impact
modes.description: A small word or adjective sits just before 'impact' or 'effect'.
modes.example: STEM literacy is also critical because it has a profound<< and>> growing impact on our day-to-day lives

modes.label: The word effect before 'of ... on'
modes.description: The word 'effect' itself, where 'of X on Y' is expected next, often in drug interaction text.
modes.example: RPV did not have a clinically significant<< effect>> on the pharmacokinetics of digox

modes.label: 'How' before affect or influence
modes.description: The word 'how' where a verb of influence is expected.
modes.example: Epigenetics is the study of<< how>> the environment can affect the function of genes

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'effects', 'impact' and 'influence'.
card.plain: It fires when the text is leading up to saying that one thing has an effect or impact on another.
